classification_rationale: Configuration evidence may be machine-readable, but the check includes multiple commands, a configuration stanza, qualifications, or parsing complexity; human review is required before implementation.
source_check_text:
Review the Cisco switch configuration to verify that it generates log records for privileged activities as shown in the example configurations below:

archive
log config
logging enable

If the Cisco switch is not configured to generate log records for privileged activities, this is a finding.
source_fix_text:
Configure the Cisco switch to generate log records for privileged activities as shown in the example below:

SW4(config)#archive
SW4(config-archive)#log config
SW4(config-archive-log-cfg)#logging enable
SW4(config-archive-log-cfg)#logging size 1000
SW4(config-archive-log-cfg)#notify syslog contenttype plaintext
SW4(config-archive-log-cfg)#hidekeys
SW4(config-archive-log-cfg)#end
title: The Cisco switch must be configured to generate log records for privileged activities.
